self.title: Investigating Copying Fidelity and Heredity Thresholds in Prebiotic Systems

detail.title: Investigating Copying Fidelity and Heredity Thresholds in Prebiotic Systems
detail.question: What minimum copying fidelity or compositional stability allows chemical systems to sustain evolution by natural selection rather than mere persistence?
detail.reason: Initial sources on prebiotic compositional heredity provide a foundation to examine inheritance stability under growth and division.
